mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_id AS orderId, o.shop_id AS shopId, oi.name AS name, COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1) AS quantity, COALESCE(oi.price, 0) AS price FROM lsc_order.order_item oi JOIN lsc_order.order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.pay_status = 1 AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND DATE(o.create_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.create_time) <= #{endDate}
